The white-haired character is very loving and treats everyone with equal kindness. He raised the red-haired character and is also very stubborn. He once left without informing anyone to pursue his own ideals. The white-haired character is skilled with a whip and in various plant and earth-related spells.

The red-haired character is someone who values profit, but he was raised to be very kind. After the white-haired character left, he became depressed and realized he has a possessive affection for the white-haired character but feels powerless. The red-haired character is skilled with a sword, can create dreams, and control temperature.

Neither of them likes rainy days. Their relationship is more familial, like a parent-child or sibling relationship, rather than that of lovers.
